ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution with an approximate 98:2 ratio of dark grey/black pixels to high-intensity white/yellow pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across central lobe surfaces; high-contrast yellowish-white clusters mapping to the extreme lateral distal tips and intermittently along the proximal leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at the central lobe convergence with an estimated vertex angle of 118 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the superior trailing margin; pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels forming a distinct sawtooth profile across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the upper trailing edges meeting at a central notch; overall trajectory sweeps upward and outward to sharpened distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups detected primarily at the far left and far right distal tips, corresponding to sessile organism colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, faint linear pixel disruptions; two diagonal grey marks visible on the right lobe surface and one faint vertical mark on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive physical accretion and surface texturing at both distal tips due to barnacle infestation, altering the natural geometric boundary of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Active water turbulence and particulate spray pattern at the base of the fluke, obscuring the precise pixel boundary of the peduncle insertion point.
